module: Auxiliary compression engine brake controller (truck "Jake brake"). It maintains a coefficient from 0 to 1 and preset levels, passes `setCompressionBrakeCoef` to the engine when the throttle is released, and publishes four electrics (setting, actual value, enabled, level index). It also forces the main controller's driving aggression to 1 while the brake is active.
notes: Jbeam keys read by init: `controlledEngine` ("mainEngine"), `electricsNameActual`, `electricsNameSetting`, `electricsNameIsEnabled`, `electricsNameLevelIndex` (by default `<engine>_compressionBrake_actual|setting|isEnabled|levelIndex`), `compressionBrakeLevels` ({0.33, 0.66, 1.0}), `clutchDisableElectricsName` ("clutchRatio").
Actual value = coefficient × (1 - sign(requestedThrottle)): 0 as soon as the throttle is requested; also forced to 0 if the clutch electrics is below 1.
If the engine is not found, init logs an error and replaces `updateGFX` with `nop`.
At startup, the active level is the last (strongest) and the coefficient is 0 (brake off).
This controller is relocated: the old name `compressionBrake` is redirected to `braking/compressionBrake`.
State saved under the keys `<name>Coef` and `<name>LevelIndex`.

setCompressionBrakeCoef.desc: Directly sets the engine brake coefficient (clamped to 0..1) and displays a UI message unless silent.

silent.desc: true to not display a message.

changeCompressionBrakeLevel.desc: Goes up or down by a number of levels (clamped) and applies the level's coefficient.

setCompressionBrakeLevel.desc: Chooses a level by its index (clamped to 1..number of levels) and applies its coefficient.

silent.desc: true to not display a message.

toggleCompressionBrakeState.desc: Turns the brake off if it is active, otherwise activates it at the stored level.

updateGFX.desc: Every frame: computes the actual coefficient, passes it to the engine when it changes, handles the main controller's aggression override and updates the electrics.

reset.desc: Forces the next transmission of the coefficient to the engine.

getState.desc: Returns the coefficient and the level index for the state save.

setState.desc: Restores the level index and the coefficient (validated values, silently).

init.desc: Finds the controlled engine, the electrics names and the levels from the jbeam.
